expect_edges.note: HQ.10: among same-stem candidates a test pairs the one sharing most directory names with it (stripe), then the nearest. Before, a spec/ test shared no qname prefix with any app/ controller, every candidate tied at 0 and the 3-target cap kept three other namespaces in candidate order (chatwoot@3564ec1e spec/controllers/stripe/callbacks_controller_spec.rb, HC.3 held-out sample 006073f089e88b00).

HQ.10: the Security test shares Acme, Core and Security with src/Acme.Core/Security and only Acme with tests/Acme.Tests.Tools (test-tree words dropped); before, the shared `tests` prefix picked the tools file (squidex@f828dd71 Squidex.Infrastructure.Tests/Security/ExtensionsTests.cs, HC.3 held-out sample 000055e3c941c3fa).
